title: Contradiction-aware knowledge publisher

stages.name: indexClaims
stages.algorithm: Extract independently checkable claims with qualifications and page context. Resolve entity references conservatively, attach author and effective period, and keep instructions separate from descriptions of historical behavior or quoted third-party views.
stages.gate: Claims retain every material negation, exception, and audience qualifier.

stages.name: compareClaims
stages.algorithm: Generate candidates through shared entities and facets, then compare meanings under aligned scope and time. Classify coexistence as legitimate when claims describe different editions or populations; record the minimum incompatible propositions when a real conflict exists.
stages.gate: Pair labels checked against scoped truth fixtures; duplicate pages add no authority.

stages.name: resolveAuthority
stages.algorithm: Consult the configured publication hierarchy and explicit supersession records. Prefer authoritative material only inside its remit; if equally authoritative sources disagree, formulate a bounded clarification rather than selecting the newest or most fluent text.
stages.gate: Unresolved decisive authority blocks publication of the disputed claim.

stages.name: composePatchSet
stages.algorithm: Draft the smallest coordinated changes that resolve the selected conflicts. Preserve unrelated claims and local audience framing; update examples, cross-links, and summaries that would otherwise repeat the corrected mistake.
stages.gate: Patch applies to exact base hash; unchanged protected claims remain semantically equivalent.

stages.name: verifyPublication
stages.algorithm: Re-extract claims from the proposed page set and repeat comparison around changed topics. Inspect whether simplification removed exceptions; build a review packet with residual disagreements and publish only after required owners approve the same patch set.
stages.gate: Zero new contradiction in protected fixtures and no unresolved blocking conflict.

operational_details: A page is edited during review: rebase only nonconflicting sections and require renewed approval for changed meaning.
A translated page lags its source: flag edition mismatch rather than calling the translation false.
A link points to an archived policy: preserve the archive but redirect current guidance explicitly.
A denied source vanishes from search: invalidate derived claims without leaking its title.
A release partially fails: retain a repair queue and do not mark the bundle fully published.
representative_episode: Two onboarding pages disagree about trial eligibility because one describes a retired plan and one contains an actual typo.
independent_truth_basis: Synthetic claim truth tables with date and audience partitions; exact patch application and link validation; independent semantic preservation judgments.
